lines: You can't drive from North America to South America. Here's why.
The Pan-American Highway network runs about 30,000 kilometers, except for one missing piece.
Between Panama and Colombia, 106 kilometers of jungle have no road at all. It's called the Darién Gap.
Plans to build it stopped in 1974, after environmental objections.
The US also feared cattle disease moving north, and Indigenous peoples want the forest left intact.
Follow for a new megaproject every day.
